name: oneiroi
description: A resident of Oneiroi as this Claude Code session's brain: her identity and agreement at session start, her memory with each message, her memory tools over MCP, and every turn captured into her transcripts.

url.title: Oneiroi URL
url.description: The platform's address, with no path.

resident.title: Resident id
resident.description: The resident this session is the brain of: the id in the address of any of her pages.

token.title: Adapter token
token.description: The brain-role adapter token Oneiroi showed once when the adapter was registered.

record_fixtures.title: Record hook payloads to
record_fixtures.description: Optional. A folder where each hook copies Claude Code's raw payload, to record real fixtures. Leave empty to record nothing.
